text: The Release can be signed with the test suite not run, or run on another commit or a dirty tree (both only inform), and with a golden report from older code: the golden report records no commit and its line never reads stale; gold verdicts given after the last golden run are not reflected.

Nothing says when the local app runs older code than the checkout: pages load new scripts on every request while the server keeps the code it started with, and Reconcile's queue cache does not refresh after decisions, the EDGAR check, rules, definitions or mappings change.

A run's report is bound to the code by a hash of HEAD's tracked files (less the run records), recomputed live at every checklist; a report written or edited by hand can still name the right hash. The binding proves the code is the code the report names, not that the tests or the golden check ran.

The Test run and Regression lines trusted the git and dirty flags a report stored; nothing read the live tree or HEAD at the checklist or at Sign, so a clean run followed by an uncommitted code edit still signed green, and a git status that failed read clean.
where: ledger/release/checklist.py tests_line, regression_line, sign; ledger/release/testreport.py git_state
